incident-triage.skill.yaml:
schema: skill/v1
name: incident-triage
description: Triage an incident report into severity, owner and next step.
environments: [test, prod]
audience: everyone
incident-triage.SKILL.md:
# Incident triage

Read the report. Decide the severity (1 to 4), the owning team and the next step. Say what you could not tell.

incident-triage.skill.yaml:
schema: skill/v1
name: incident-triage
description: Triage an incident report into severity, owner and next step.
environments: [test, prod]
audience: everyone
incident-triage.SKILL.md:
# Incident triage

Read the report. Decide the severity (1 to 4), the owning team and the next step. Say what you could not tell. For severity 1, follow checklists/sev1.md.
incident-triage.checklists/sev1.md:
# Severity 1

1. Page the owning team.
2. Open the incident channel.
3. Write the first update within 15 minutes.

audience: everyone
release-notes.SKILL.md:
